This is the crates.io release of gpui_util 0.2.2. The manifest updates the
optional test-support dependency Git2 to 0.21 for the fixes in
[RUSTSEC-2026-0183](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0183) and
[RUSTSEC-2026-0184](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0184).
The implementation is unchanged.
